entities.name: Phyrexian language
entities.description: A complete written and spoken language of the Phyrexians, passed down through glistening oil.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Machine-based beings who prefer consonants, dislike nasal sounds, and borrow harsh sounds and titles.

entities.name: Glistening oil
entities.description: The medium through which knowledge of the Phyrexian language is passed on.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor whose followers see scratched writing as rustic.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor whose followers see scratched writing as rustic.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor whose followers view scratched writing as an art.

relations.note: Knowledge of the language is passed through glistening oil.
relations.quote: passed since the old Phyrexian culture through glistening oil

relations.note: Their followers differ on scratched writing: Jin-Gitaxias's and Elesh Norn's see it as rustic, Urabrask's as art.
relations.quote: followers of Urabrask view it as an art
